jp.name: トップアイドル パシフィカ
jp.text:

[AUTO](VC/RC):[Soul-Blast 8 & Counter-Blast 5] When this unit's attack hits a vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to three <Bermuda Triangle>, call them to separate (RC), and shuffle your deck.
